function_question: How does nature keep heat out?

opening.text: There was a boy called Leo who loved sports day more than any other day of the school year.
Every sports day, Leo's team ran the ice pop stall on the field, handing out cold treats to hot, tired runners.
The sun was blazing, and by the last race every ice pop had melted into sticky juice. "There's no freezer and no power out here," Leo sighed. "How can we keep them frozen?"

card.problem: Ice pops melt in the sun

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: A sticky sports day
chapters.line: Leo holds a melted ice pop and wonders: how can we keep it frozen with no freezer?

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: Leo asks for help
chapters.line: Leo has lots of questions, and he needs a teammate. What about you?

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: The nature heroes
chapters.line: You and Leo travel from icy poles to hot deserts to meet the masters of heat.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: The secret of still air
chapters.line: The heroes share the secret they all use.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: Training in the melt lab
chapters.line: Every hero needs training. Leo hands you three ice cubes and a stopwatch.

chapters.label: Chapter 5½
chapters.title: The idea map
chapters.line: Leo writes "keep it cold" in the middle of a big sheet of paper.

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: The plan
chapters.line: Every great pouch starts as a drawing.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: The big test
chapters.line: The first cube drips too soon. You fix it, and try again.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: Frozen at the finish line
chapters.line: The last runner crosses the line, and the ice pops are still frozen.

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. Leo needs his ice pops to stay frozen all through sports day. Can you help him? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some engineers already have a spark of an idea. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Nature solved this long ago. Tap each card to meet four nature heroes who are masters of heat. One of them is a penguin, just like me!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four heroes share…
guide.skill: Scientists predict before they test. Which wrap will keep an ice cube frozen the longest?
guide.sketch: Time to draw your pouch cut in half, like a real engineer!
guide.build_and_test: Build your pouch and let's see how long Leo's ice cube lasts in the sun!
guide.retry_tip: Engineers never stop at round 1. Change ONE thing and test again!
guide.ending: And ever since then, Leo's team packs their ice pops in YOUR pouch. Every runner gets a frozen treat, even after the very last race!

quick_check.question: The control cube melts in 10 minutes. Leo wants his cube to last 3 times longer. How long is that?
quick_check.right: Right! 3 × 10 = 30 minutes. Beat that, and your pouch is a real winner!
quick_check.wrong: Not quite. Try 10 minutes, 3 times over.

clue_cards.name: Polar bear
clue_cards.trick: Hollow guard hairs over thick, dense underfur.
clue_cards.does: Traps still air, so body heat barely leaks out.

clue_cards.name: Emperor penguins
clue_cards.does: Cuts each bird's exposed surface and heat loss by up to half.

clue_cards.name: Camel
clue_cards.does: Blocks the sun's heat, so it sweats less than a shaved camel.

clue_cards.name: Arctic fox
clue_cards.trick: Curls up and wraps its tail over its face.
clue_cards.does: Shrinks the surface touching the cold air.

predict.prompt: Keeps heat out or lets it in? Predict first!
predict.explain: Metal passes heat along fast. Bubble wrap traps still air, which is a poor conductor, and shiny foil bounces sunlight away.

lab.title: The melt lab
lab.predict: Which wrap will keep the ice cube frozen the longest?

tool.name: Mind map
tool.intro: A mind map grows your ideas like a tree, from one big question in the middle. You've met every piece before. Today you'll use all 5 pieces together!

parts.name: Centre
parts.what: Put the big question in the middle.
parts.example: 🍱 "A better lunchbox" goes in the middle.
parts.starter: In the centre of my map I write…

parts.name: Branches
parts.what: Draw lines out to the main topics.
parts.example: 🍱 Branches: keeps food fresh, easy to carry, no spills.
parts.starter: My three branches are conduction, convection and…

parts.name: Twigs
parts.what: Add smaller ideas to each branch.
parts.example: 🍱 On "no spills": clip lid, rubber seal, separate pots.
parts.starter: On the "radiation" branch I add the camel's fur and…

parts.name: Pictures
parts.what: Doodle quick icons next to your ideas.
parts.example: 🍱 A tiny padlock drawn next to "clip lid".

parts.name: Links
parts.what: Join ideas on different branches with a line.
parts.example: 🍱 "Rubber seal" links to "keeps food fresh": it does both!
parts.starter: A line joins the penguin huddle to…
